summary: First full-cycle test of Sentinel AI (FastAPI + React + MongoDB). Ran 23 pytest backend tests (all passing) covering auth/cookies+Bearer, cameras CRUD + RBAC, events search/filter/delete/CSV, dashboard stats, reports summary + PDF, settings GET/PUT, users admin-only, real YOLO image detection, and live simulate. Ran Playwright e2e for login (quick-login admin/operator/viewer), navigation across all 8 pages, dashboard stats + charts, live monitoring with simulated bounding boxes, image upload -> YOLO annotated result, camera add/rename/toggle/reconnect/delete, event search, settings save, reports/PDF, role-based UI hiding. Everything works end-to-end.

minor.issue: Server sets Content-Disposition filename=events.csv but frontend overrides to sentinel_events.csv on client-side download - functional, but backend header inconsistent with spec.

issues: Bar chart X-axis renders but bars appear very thin/invisible for small dataset; consider using horizontal orientation or minBarSize.

action_items: (Optional) Align backend CSV filename with sentinel_events.csv for consistency.
(Optional cosmetic) Improve Events-by-Type bar visibility in Reports page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (670 lines) is large - consider splitting into routers/ (auth, cameras, events, users, detection, reports, dashboard) for maintainability.
get_current_user is duplicated between server.py and auth_utils.get_current_user_factory. Pick one and reuse.
CORS is set to allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True - browsers reject wildcard with credentials in strict mode; explicit origin list recommended if cookie auth is enforced cross-site.
_log_upload_events computes settings on every upload - could be cached (minor).

reports/pdf builds Table from `[[...]] + [...] or [['No data','']]` - Python precedence: `A + B or C` evaluates A+B first, so 'No data' fallback only triggers if the sum is falsy (empty list). Fine here, but slightly obscure - use explicit conditional.
Frontend Cameras/Users pages depend on API completion for card rendering - fine, but consider a loading skeleton (initial test race condition would be avoided by user perception too).
test_credentials: admin@sentinel.ai/Admin@123, operator@sentinel.ai/Operator@123, viewer@sentinel.ai/Viewer@123 - all working, seeded correctly.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 3 users, 6 cameras, 120 events on startup - verified via API. Test cleaned up its own TEST_ / UI_TEST_ created cameras.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 23 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass against public URL. Settings schema uses `confidence_threshold`, `iou_threshold`, `detection_classes`, `processing_resolution` (not the abbreviations from the review spec). Live simulate endpoint returns {detections, counts}. Real YOLO runs on /api/detect/image with ~1s for tiny images. UI has all required data-testid attributes. Simulated live-stream mocking is intentional (per user's choice) - flagged as MOCKED in review request. Dashboard telemetry (fps/cpu/inference_ms) is randomized - also MOCKED as documented.
